primary_gt.mechanism_question: test whether multiday rainfall loading translates into routed river or basin response instead of an instantaneous local anomaly

chain_evidence_synthesis.formula: cutoff_low AND anchored_rainfall_zone AND EFI >= 0.8 AND station_3day_max_mm >= 400 AND event_window_days >= 7 AND gdacs_alert_duration_h >= 120
chain_evidence_synthesis.diagnostic_diagnostic_test_or_test: all persistence tests pass; the 144.0 h value is GDACS flood-alert duration, while the full event window is 10 inclusive days
chain_evidence_synthesis.hydrologic_implication: persistent rainfall forcing is established without treating alert duration as the whole event window
the station peak is much sharper than the gridded maxima
the gridded products agree on broad event precipitation

chain_evidence_synthesis.formula: return_period_years >= 20 AND flow_multiplier > 5.0 AND extreme_river_length_km >= 8000 AND major_basins_named
chain_evidence_synthesis.hydrologic_implication: major-river exceedance is consistent with routed basin flooding
Romania flash flooding is a local branch, not the event-wide diagnosis

primary_gt.decisive_evidence: Timing, persistence, and basin-scale response are decisive; isolated rainfall maxima are anchors but not the whole process.
primary_gt.rejected_simplifications: Reject single-day, single-product, or same-hour response explanations if lagged or routed evidence is stronger.
primary_gt.bounded_interpretation: The package supports timing and process reasoning, not calibrated hydraulic forecasts or complete damage accounting.

criteria.name: mechanism_diagnosis
criteria.description: Identifies the dominant physical process and gives the correct compact answer label or an equivalent diagnosis.

criteria.name: computed_evidence
criteria.description: Recomputes the quantitative evidence inherited from the original task and preserves units, signs, ratios, and key values.

criteria.name: evidence_weighting
criteria.description: Explains which evidence streams are decisive and which are contextual or weaker proxies.

criteria.name: counterfactual_rejection
criteria.description: Rejects at least one tempting simplified explanation using the computed values rather than assertion.

criteria.name: bounded_interpretation
criteria.description: States scale, timing, proxy, or uncertainty limits without adding unsupported losses or impacts.

criteria.name: json_contract
criteria.description: Returns the requested structured mechanism-diagnosis JSON without reducing the answer to a row-only table or same-scale checklist.
